results.name: Landmine Kneeling Twist
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at chest height with both hands, arms extended.
Brace your core and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to bring the bar down in an arc toward one hip.
Return through the centre with control and continue to the other side.
tips: Let the movement come from your torso, not your arms.
Keep your glutes tight so your hips stay square.
results.description: Landmine Kneeling Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.

results.name: Landmine Oblique Twist
instructions: Stand facing the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the end of the bar at chest height with both hands.
Extend your arms and brace your core.
Rotate your torso and pivot your back foot to swing the bar in an arc down toward one hip.
Bring the bar back over the top with control and repeat to the other side.
tips: Keep your arms long and the movement smooth.
Pivot your feet so your lower back doesn't twist under load.
results.description: Landmine Oblique Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Landmine Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor beside the landmine with your knees bent and heels on the ground.
Hold the end of the bar with both hands above your chest and lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to lower the bar toward the floor on one side.
Bring it back over the top with control and lower it to the other side.
tips: Keep your chest open; don't round your back.
Lift your feet off the floor to make it harder.
results.description: Landmine Russian Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Leg Lift Circles
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms at your sides, palms facing down.
Lift both legs off the floor, about a foot above the floor, keeping your legs straight and your core engaged.
Begin to draw small circles in the air with both legs moving together in a controlled and steady motion. Perform the circles in one direction for a set number of repetitions.
Switch directions and draw circles with both legs in the opposite direction for the same number of repetitions. Lower your legs back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your legs as straight as possible to maximize the stretch and engagement in your hip flexors and quadriceps.
Perform the exercise on a comfortable, non-slip surface to prevent discomfort or injury.
If you find it difficult to keep your legs straight, you can start with smaller circles and gradually increase the size as you build strength and flexibility.
results.description: Leg Lift Circles is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Abductors.

results.name: Long Arm Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Extend your arms straight in line with your head, keeping them close to your ears, and hands crossed over each other.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the floor, with your arms following your torso line, until it forms a 45-degree angle with the floor.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly lower your body back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms straight and aligned with your ears to ensure proper form and avoid straining your neck.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor throughout the exercise to prevent lower back strain.
Use a comfortable, non-slip exercise mat to provide cushioning and prevent slipping during the movement.
results.description: Long Arm Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Long Lever Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank, then walk your elbows forward so they are in front of your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core hard and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position for the set time while breathing steadily.
tips: The further your elbows are in front, the harder it gets.
Don't let your hips sag or your lower back arch.
results.description: Long Lever Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Lying Abs Resistance Band
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Attach the resistance band to a low anchor point behind your head and hold the handles with both hands, keeping your arms bent and handles close to your head.
Curl your upper body, bringing your elbows towards your knees while lifting your back off the floor.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you curl your torso up and inhale as you lower it back down.
Keep your feet flat on the floor for better stability.
Focus on engaging your abdominal muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Lying Abs Resistance Band is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms at your sides, palms facing down firm on the floor.
Engage your core muscles and press your lower back into the floor.
Keeping your legs straight, lift them up towards the ceiling until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control, stopping just before they touch the floor. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lift your legs up and inhale as you lower them back down.
Keep your legs as straight as possible for maximum effectiveness.
Focus on engaging your abdominal muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Lying Leg Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Med Ball Half Kneeling Wood Choppers
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
Start with the ball beside your hip on the side of the down knee.
Rotate your torso and lift the ball diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Return along the same path with control, then switch sides after the set.
tips: Keep your hips facing forward and squeeze the glute of the down leg.
Move with control; let your torso, not your arms, do the work.
results.description: Med Ball Half Kneeling Wood Choppers is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Med Ball Toe Touches
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Hold a medicine ball with both hands above your chest, arms straight.
Curl your shoulders off the floor and reach the ball up toward your toes.
Lower your shoulders with control and repeat.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Exhale as you reach up.
results.description: Med Ball Toe Touches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.
